name: Using Talents
overview: Scripture reveals that God entrusts each believer with unique gifts and talents according to His grace, calling us to use them faithfully and diligently as servants of His kingdom. Our abilities open doors and grant influence when exercised wisely, as a man's gift brings him before great men. Believers are called to shine as lights in the world, actively engaging their talents to glorify God in all they do. Moreover, the principle of stewardship is clear: those who use their gifts will receive greater blessing, while neglect leads to loss, emphasizing wholehearted service to the Lord rather than to men.
